name: SA3D
aliases: Segment Anything in 3D with Radiance Fields
definition: A method building upon SAM to generate initial 2D masks with prompts in a single view, then alternating between mask inverse rendering and cross-view self-prompting to iteratively refine the 3D mask until complete object segmentation is achieved.
summary: SA3D is a 3D segmentation method using 3D Gaussian Splatting and SAM that iteratively refines masks via cross-view self-prompting, eliminating the need for manual multi-view annotation.
